subject: Follow-up letter - IMV 24-25 Sep 2026, Regimen G
body:
Dear Dr. Bhatt and team,

Thank you for hosting the interim monitoring visit on 24-25 September 2026. Below is a summary. Please respond to open items by 13 October.

1. Regulatory / ISF
- Delegation log current; all RG staff have signed. GCP and protocol training certificates filed for all, including the two new coordinators.
- NEALS ALSFRS-R and SVC certificates in date for all evaluators. C-SSRS certificates filed.
- Regimen G ICF v5.0 sIRB approval letter filed.

2. Informed consent (6 participants reviewed)
- Master Protocol and Regimen G ICFs signed and dated by participant and consenter before any study procedures for all 6. Copies given documented in notes. No issues.

3. Source / EDC
- SVC printouts with all trials retained for all visits reviewed. Height from screening used throughout.
- ECG tracings filed with central reader reports.
- G-313-003 drug accountability log, Week 8 line: returned packet count was changed from "6" to "2" using correction fluid, with "2" written over it and no initials/date. Please see GCP/protocol requirements on corrections and add a note to file.
- Visits entered in EDC within 1-3 days of the visit for all participants reviewed.

4. Investigational product
- Drug room secure; access list matches the delegation log. Shelf count matches IRT.
- Receipt records and transit logger printouts on file for all 4 shipments.
- Daily temperature log: no entries for Sat 19 Sep and Sun 20 Sep. The monitor download for those days could not be retrieved (device memory overwritten). All other days 19-27 C.

5. Biological samples
- Freezer log complete. Shipment manifests filed.
- In the -80, 3 biomarker serum cryovials for G-313-005 (Week 8) were hand-labeled with the participant's initials and date of birth because the kit label printer was down. Please relabel per the Lab Manual and confirm.

6. Other
- PD log in EDC up to date.

Next IMV planned for late November.

Kind regards,
Greg Mills
Clinical Research Associate
